content.value: The following perpendicular offsets were taken from chain line to an irregular (10) boundary at 10 m interval: 3.10, 4.20, 5.35, 6.45, 7.15, 8.25, 7.95 and 5.20 m. Calculate the area between chain line, the boundary and the end offsets by trapezoidal rule.
